base_graph.message_emission: one message per required schema per communication tick

bounded_delay_loss.delivery_quantization: first communication tick at or after send_time+delay

communication_degradation_contract.candidate_matching: same counter-keyed schedule for both candidates; range gating may differ with candidate state

diameter.protocol_rounds: derived from the declared component-diameter bound

freshness.stale_behavior: exclude from local neighbour table and all agreements

temporary_disconnection_then_restore.base_delay_and_loss: same stored F8 delay_s and packet_loss process
temporary_disconnection_then_restore.cut_rule: drop every cross-partition message between role ordinals below and above ceil(N/2)
temporary_disconnection_then_restore.outcome_treatment: valid task-negative when the violation prevents completion; never generation-invalid by itself
temporary_disconnection_then_restore.restoration: resume distance graph with empty cross-cut queues at first tick after duration

counterfactual_execution_contract.candidate_differs_from_active_target: do not supersede; resolve or abort active lifecycle, wait for REARMED, then issue candidate if horizon remains
counterfactual_execution_contract.candidate_equals_current: hold or continue; no source-equals-target epoch
counterfactual_execution_contract.candidate_injection_time: same next communication tick in both clones
counterfactual_execution_contract.candidate_timeout: remaining episode horizon; no independent hidden timeout
counterfactual_execution_contract.clone_rule: two independent deep clones with byte-identical canonical snapshot hash
counterfactual_execution_contract.invalid_pair: generation-invalid pair; emit no training row and never replace
counterfactual_execution_contract.replicas: one except three matched replicas for F8 and F9
counterfactual_execution_contract.rollout_start: resolved decision-event timestamp after source step completion

disturbance_contract.invalidity: nonfinite generated value or magnitude outside the declared bound
disturbance_contract.reset: all counter identities reset to the frozen episode or replica seed

robot_acceleration.candidate_matching: same vector for matching robot and step
robot_acceleration.counterfactual_rollout: independent per-robot per-control-step uniform disk with maximum magnitude 0.05*maximum_acceleration, added before safety projection

dynamic_obstacle_contract.acceleration: zero inside a segment; velocity changes atomically at waypoint timestamps
dynamic_obstacle_contract.after_last_waypoint: hold final pose with zero velocity
dynamic_obstacle_contract.before_first_waypoint: hold first pose with zero velocity
dynamic_obstacle_contract.candidate_matching: identical snapshot and dynamic_obstacle seed for both candidates
dynamic_obstacle_contract.collision: continuous swept circle against linearly interpolated robot centers
dynamic_obstacle_contract.declared_obstacle_speed_disposition: audit-only family-range descriptor; waypoint timestamps win because they form complete position-time pairs
dynamic_obstacle_contract.invalidity: nonpositive radius, nonfinite waypoint, or nonincreasing waypoint time
dynamic_obstacle_contract.position_update: linear interpolation in absolute episode time on each waypoint segment
dynamic_obstacle_contract.rejected_speed_alternative: constant declared speed cannot satisfy the frozen waypoint endpoint times
dynamic_obstacle_contract.velocity_update: constant segment displacement divided by segment duration

final_test_access_policy.metadata_source: approved Phase 8 protocol manifest and split contract; sealed layout records not opened

initialization_contract.communication_state: sequence counters zero; neighbour tables empty; PRF counter zero
initialization_contract.controller_local_state: new RobotLocalController per robot with empty mutable history

initial_topology.line_exception: only an explicit frozen narrow-start declaration; none exists in v1 layouts

initialization_contract.invalidity_handling: record one rejected scientific slot; never resample or replace
initialization_contract.mission_progress: zero with maximum-progress origin at initial fitted topology origin

velocity_perturbation.clipping: reject if Euclidean speed exceeds maximum_speed

centerline_semantics.passage_length_formula: sum Euclidean segment lengths after entry/exit clipping
centerline_semantics.rejected_spline_alternative: rejected because spline tension and endpoint derivatives are absent from ScenarioLayout

family_compilers.F1: explicit static circles; no confining passage
family_compilers.F2: one straight_corridor active on stored x0..x1
family_compilers.F3: polyline tube active from first interior x to its reflected exit x
family_compilers.F4: piecewise-linear S tube active between first and last interior control points
family_compilers.F5: two independent straight_corridor tubes in declaration order
family_compilers.F6: central circle plus declared polyline bypass with circular fillet radius parameter
family_compilers.F7: explicit static circles; no confining passage
family_compilers.F8: one straight_corridor plus the F8 communication contract
family_compilers.F9: no static passage; one timestamp-authoritative moving circle

invalidity_conditions: unknown schema, generator, split, family, topology, or primitive
nonfinite value, nonpositive width/radius/horizon, or nonmonotone waypoint time
start equals goal or centreline x is not monotone
primitive or inflated robot center leaves the declared world bounds
initial role state collides or lies outside robot-center bounds
declared passage width disagrees with primitive width
bypass flag or family-specific canonical parameter is inconsistent

layout_field_dispositions.consumption: free width between analytic inner boundaries
select nominal, bounded, or disconnection process
initial committed topology and role template

world_frame.bounds_rationale: contains the N=24 LINE half-length at both frozen start and goal, all declared family geometry ranges, and configured clearances

seed_binding.closed_interval_mapping: a+(b-a)*u; upper endpoint is approached but not exceeded
seed_binding.final_test: seed construction rejected without the existing one-time authorization gate

streams.dynamic_obstacle: source_job.seeds.dynamic_obstacle; deterministic v1 path uses no random draw

simulator_semantics.clock: integer control step multiplied by control period
simulator_semantics.collision_checking: continuous swept check plus control-boundary state checks
simulator_semantics.timeout: first control boundary at or beyond absolute horizon

sensor_conversion.analytic_boundary: sample each visible inner boundary component by arc length, include endpoints, and place support-disc centers one support radius into occupied space
sensor_conversion.circle: relative center and true radius when center distance <= R_obs
sensor_conversion.ordering: distance, primitive index, boundary side, arc index
sensor_conversion.robot_visibility: only ego-relative current support discs within R_obs
sensor_conversion.sampling_anchor: component start in canonical primitive order

truth_geometry.corridor: inside active longitudinal slab, occupied space is the world-bound complement of the closed centreline tube of half-width width/2
